name: 2sic-standard-skin-template
description: The default skin template for 2sic websites

scripts.build-prod: concurrently -n vite,tsc -c cyan,yellow "npm run build:vite" "npm run build:tsc"
scripts.update-lib-bootstrap: (ROBOCOPY node_modules\bootstrap\dist\js dist\lib bootstrap.bundle.min.js bootstrap.bundle.js.map ) ^& IF %ERRORLEVEL% LEQ 1 exit 0
